rendered: The document does not say the authors chose copper current collectors. Their anode-free cell is built on aluminum. They explicitly chose Al over Cu: Al was selected instead of[1] Cu because it offers significant cost[2] and weight advantages, which the authors tie to transitioning to sodium-based chemistries (lower cost and lower weight than copper). Copper appears only as a comparison point: previous work using Cu electrodes reported nearly double the hysteresis at[3] a high current, and the authors compare their carbon/Al electrodes against that result (Figure S4).
